natural_empirical.scope: Empirical native distribution TV includes Unknown, __other__, and __unparsed__ on the complete planned-draw denominator. Finite draws (e.g. 16) induce plug-in TV bias, generally upward for independent samples; matched seeds change that bias. Draws are not independent families. This is separate from greedy agreement and restricted candidate TV.

qwen.scope: Requested-occupation strata; all planned failures/unknowns retained. RD conditions on binary qualified outputs and is undefined at zero coverage. J is balanced qualified yield, not a pure-quality or pure-fairness metric. Observations are proxies unless separately human-validated.
